test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: To pack a set of books, Gautam got cartons of a certain height that were 48 inches long and 27 inches wide. If the volume of such a carton was 22.5 cubic feet, what was the height of each carton? [Use 1 foot = 12 inches.]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the given volume directly into cubic inches by multiplying by 12³.

Volume in inches = 22.5 × 1728 = 38880 inch³

Since Volume = Length × Width × Height

Height = 38880 ÷ (48 × 27)

Height = 38880 ÷ 1296 = 30 inches

**∴ The correct answer is 30 inches.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length (L) = 48 inches

Width (B) = 27 inches

Volume (V) = 22.5 ft³

1 ft = 12 inches

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cuboid = L × B × H

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/256eb8e942bdca11b442bd41172b46ba61b82d9a5be75aa6f63e860a38fdc32f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume in inch³ = 22.5 × 12 × 12 × 12

⇒ Volume = 22.5 × 1728 = 38880 inch³

⇒ L × B × H = 38880

⇒ 48 × 27 × H = 38880

⇒ 1296 × H = 38880

⇒ H = 38880 ÷ 1296

⇒ H = 30 inches

**∴ The correct answer is 30 inches.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cuboid

V = L × B × H, where L, B, and H denote length, breadth, and height respectively.

Surface Area of a Cuboid

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2(LB + BH + HL). Lateral Surface Area (LSA) = 2H(L + B).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The length of the longest space diagonal inside a cuboid is √(L² + B² + H²).

Unit Conversions

Since 1 foot = 12 inches, calculating volume requires taking the cube of 12. Thus, 1 cubic foot = 12³ = 1728 cubic inches.
